quests.name: Timbermaw Ally
quests.summary: Grazle wants you to prove yourself by killing 5 Deadwood Warriors, 5 Deadwood Pathfinders, and 5 Deadwood Gardeners.

quests.name: Timbermaw Ally
quests.summary: Grazle wants you to prove yourself by killing 6 Deadwood Warriors, 6 Deadwood Pathfinders, and 6 Deadwood Gardeners.  Return to him in southern Felwood near the Emerald Sanctuary when you are done.

quests.name: What Niby Commands
quests.summary: Speak with Impsy in Felwood.

quests.name: A Husband's Last Battle
quests.summary: Kill Overlord Ror and return his claw to Dreka'Sur at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

quests.name: Forces of Jaedenar
quests.summary: Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Collection of the Corrupt Water
quests.summary: Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Hot and Itchy
quests.summary: Bring a piece of felcloth to Impsy in Felwood.

quests.name: Seeking Spiritual Aid
quests.summary: Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

quests.name: The Wrong Stuff
quests.summary: Bring 10 Rotting Wood and 4 Bloodvenom Essence to Impsy in Felwood.

quests.name: Trolls of a Feather
quests.summary: Bring a total of 6 Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in sunken temple.

quests.name: Cleansed Water Returns to Felwood
quests.summary: Take the Purified Moon Well Water to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Corrupted Sabers
quests.summary: Take Winna's kitten to the corrupted moon well, release it, then bring it back to Winna.Once you have returned to Winna, click on the cat to release it to Winna.

quests.name: Felbound Ancients
quests.summary: Travel to Darnassus and use Eridan's Vial to collect a Vial of Blessed Water from the Temple of the Moon. Return to Eridan with the filled vial.

quests.name: Flute of Xavaric
quests.summary: Bring the Flute of Xavaric and 5 Jadefire Felbind samples to Eridan Bluewind in southern Felwood.

quests.name: Further Corruption
quests.summary: Eridan Bluewind in Felwood wants you to kill 8 Jadefire Hellcallers, 8 Jadefire Betrayers, 8 Jadefire Tricksters, and Xavaric. Return to Eridan when the task is completed.

quests.name: Purified!
quests.summary: Speak to Eridan again in a moment.

quests.name: The Corruption of the Jadefire
quests.summary: Kill 11 Jadefire Felsworns, 9 Jadefire Shadowstalkers, 9 Jadefire Rogues, and Xavathras. Return to Eridan Bluewind in Felwood when the task has been completed.

quests.name: Verifying the Corruption
quests.summary: Seek out and destroy 2 Entropic Beasts and 2 Entropic Horrors while exploring Shatter Scar Vale. After checking to see if the craters there are still filled with corrupt fel water, return to Taronn Redfeather in Felwood.

quests.name: Well of Corruption
quests.summary: Collect a sample of corrupted water from the Jadefire Satyrs' moonwell and bring it to Winna Hazzard at Bloodvenom Post.

quests.name: A Strange Red Key
quests.summary: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.

quests.name: Cleansing Felwood
quests.summary: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Arathandris Silversky in Felwood.

quests.name: Cleansing Felwood
quests.summary: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Maybess Riverbreeze in Felwood.

quests.name: Deadwood Ritual Totem
quests.summary: Take the Deadwood Ritual Totem inside Timbermaw Hold and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item.  The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of Neutral reputation or greater with them.

quests.name: Dousing the Flames of Protection
quests.summary: Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.

quests.name: Feathers for Grazle
quests.summary: While you have proven yourself to me, you may need to continue to work toward proving yourself to the suspicious brethren of my tribe.  To that end, I may be able to continue assisting you.Some of the Deadwood furbolgs wear a distinctive headdress that may be used as a means of proof in thinning their numbers.  Bring me a feather from any headdresses you acquire; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.

quests.name: Feathers for Nafien
quests.summary: While you have proven yourself to me, you may need to continue to work toward proving yourself to the suspicious brethren of my tribe.  To that end, I may be able to continue assisting you.Some of the Deadwood furbolgs wear a distinctive headdress that may be used as a means of proof in thinning their numbers.  Bring me a feather from any headdresses you acquire; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.

quests.name: Flawless Fel Essence
quests.summary: Impsy in Felwood has asked that you bring him three Flawless Fel Essences originating from three distinct locations.The Legashi Satyrs of Azshara hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Jaedenar Legionnaires of Jaedenar hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Felguard Sentries of the Blasted Lands hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region.Recover the Flawless Fel Essences and return  to Impsy in Felwood.

quests.name: Kroshius' Infernal Core
quests.summary: Search Shatter Scar Vale in Felwood for the remains of Kroshius. When you locate the remains, use the Fel Fire near them and await Kroshius' return. When the infernal has awoken, slay him and take from his corpse Kroshius' Infernal Core.Return Kroshius' Infernal Core to Niby the Almighty in Felwood.

quests.name: Rescue From Jaedenar
quests.summary: Escort Arko'narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold. Afterwards, seek out Jessir Moonbow in Felwood to let her know what's happened to her friends.

quests.name: Salve via Disenchanting
quests.summary: The power of a disenchanted magical item is felt by the essence it creates.  I've devised a way to turn raw essence used by enchanters into a suitable reagent for creating Cenarion plant salve.  You don't need a Cenarion beacon for this; any suitably disenchanted item that yields lesser nether essences will work.I just need a single lesser nether essence; in exchange, I will give you Cenarion plant salves.  The essence is extremely potent - a little definitely goes a long way!

quests.name: Salve via Gathering
quests.summary: A Cenarion beacon allows a seasoned herbalist to spot insidious fel creep - a malfeasant product of Felwood's corruption.  My work here has taught me the knowledge of purifying fel creep into a cleansing reagent... used in what we now refer to as Cenarion plant salve.When you gather herbs in Felwood, you should encounter the fel creep so long as you have the beacon.  In exchange for what you bring to me, I will give you pre-made Cenarion plant salve.

I grind shards into a usable reagent that goes into making Cenarion plant salve.  We will use that salve to turn corrupted plants into healthy ones again.In exchange for these shards, I will give you some Cenarion plant salves I have already prepared.

quests.name: Speak to Nafien
quests.summary: Travel north along the main road in Felwood and speak with the furbolg named Nafien.  He stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.

quests.name: Speak to Salfa
quests.summary: Travel through Timbermaw Hold and exit into Winterspring.  Speak with Salfa, who stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.

quests.name: Ancient Spirit
quests.summary: Escort Arei to safety, then speak with Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song, in eastern Ashenvale.

quests.name: Beads for Salfa
quests.summary: You've certainly earned my trust, <name>, but you may need to continue to earn the trust of my untrusting tribe.  There is something you can do to earn that trust.The Winterfall are known to carry spirit beads to ward against foul spirits.  These beads have clearly failed in their purpose, as the Winterfall themselves are the agents of corruption.  Bring to me these spirit beads from fallen Winterfall furbolgs; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.

quests.name: To Winterspring!
quests.summary: Find Starfall Village in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.

quests.name: Wild Guardians
quests.summary: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to kill 15 Raging Owlbeasts and 15 Ragged Owlbeasts.

quests.name: Retribution of the Light
quests.summary: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.

quests.name: The Remains of Trey Lightforge
quests.summary: Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in Felwood.

quests.name: A Final Blow
quests.summary: Kill Moora and Salia, and bring Shadow Lord Fel'dan's Head to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Ulathek the Traitor
quests.summary: Confront Ulathek, then bring The Traitor's Heart to Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar.

quests.name: Wild Guardians
quests.summary: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 13 Moontouched Owlbeasts.

quests.name: Wild Guardians
quests.summary: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 10 Berserk Owlbeasts in Winterspring.

quests.name: A Proper String
quests.summary: Stoma the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Black Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Stoma in Felwood.

quests.name: An Introduction
quests.summary: Your diligence and integrity has been noted, <class>.We are Ancients: Protectors of this once great forest. Our physical forms were destroyed 10,000 years ago when Archimonde and the Burning Legion marched upon Hyjal. Our spirits, however, remain intact.There are tasks that we can offer. Tasks that if completed will open up the secrets of the Ancients to you.Know this, should you complete these tasks, merely return to this rock and we shall answer the calling.

quests.name: Ancient Sinew Wrapped Lamina
quests.summary: Hastat the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Blue Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Hastat in Felwood.

quests.name: Stave of the Ancients
quests.summary: You must find and destroy these four demonic corrupters:Simone the Seductress.Klinfran the Crazed.Solenor the Slayer.Artorius the Doombringer.Destroy these creatures and return to Vartrus the Ancient in Felwood with their heads.Refer to the Petrified Bark in your inventory for clues as to their whereabouts.You MUST complete this task by yourself.

quests.name: Xorothian Stardust
quests.summary: Purchase Xorothian Stardust from Ur'dan.  Bring it to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.
